slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US via Amazon in 2027, staged behind an ad-cost gate: the only US route within the board's limits, it pays back only below 28.6% ACoS
The US is worth entering, and Amazon is the way in: K-beauty is gaining share and Onsoo's test is growing fast
–	Amazon has 41% of US K-beauty skincare sales; 61% of buyers shop there most
–	Pilot sales grew 89% in six months, but repeat is 29%, against 48% in Korea
The retail-led route breaks all three board limits and rests on sell-through Onsoo has not earned
–	Its cash need passes the $18M cap in 2029 and reaches $20.8M by 2030
–	Group margin would fall to 4.5% in 2027, below the 8% floor
Amazon-led fits the limits, but only just, and reaches $26.4M rather than $40M by 2030
–	Payback by 2030 needs ACoS below 28.6% on average; the pilot ran at 28%
–	Japan returns more cash above 25.9% ACoS but builds only a $7M business
Launch in stages: commit to 2027, decide 2028 on ad cost and the tariff, add retail only above 20% awareness
–	Four gates: ACoS, US labels, repeat at 31%, and 20% awareness for retail
–	National retail in 2029 would leave the US $11.9M short of payback in 2030

slides.title: Option A pays back by 2030 only while advertising averages below about 28.6% of Amazon sales

paragraphs.text: 1 Opportunity    2 Retail-led    3 Amazon-led    4 Launch plan
Option A pays back by 2030 only while advertising averages below about 28.6% of Amazon sales

cash Option A earns in 2027–30 before advertising: $30.1M of contribution less $10.9M of fixed costs, setup and inventory
Amazon sales 2027–30 at the planning team's volumes and $24 a unit
the highest average ACoS at which cumulative cash is back to zero by end-2030
The threshold sits just above the pilot and well below the scale benchmark
▪	The pilot ran at 28% on a small budget; the plan assumes 25% because ACoS falls as the brand matures
▪	Agency data shows the opposite at scale: brands growing from $5M to $20M a year run a median 32% (26%–38%)
▪	If the duty rises from 15% to 25% in mid-2027, the threshold falls to about 26.9%
▪	Volumes, fees and fixed costs are the planning team's; a weaker won would raise the threshold, a stronger one lower it
1  Team model from the planning team's inputs (briefing pack Tables 4–7); live formulas in the source workbook; the average is weighted by sales, so a costly first year can be offset later
Sources: Onsoo Botanicals US market entry briefing pack (synthetic benchmark data); team analysis
